description: Every field a call to mocks may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

counts.description: how many records of a type, one line each: `posts: 40`, `comments: 120`, `people: 20`; 24 posts, three replies a post, 16 people and 8 groups when left out

endpoints.description: endpoint lines over the package's own, in network's line, for an endpoint the package's api.json lacks

entities.description: entity lines over the package's own, in the models line

package.description: the client package's folder, relative to the project (`Packages/RecipeKit`); found by its api.json when left out

rounds.description: how many answers the model may give one batch; 3 when left out

scenarios.description: the scenarios the package's tests prove: normal, empty, failing, unauthorized, slow; every one when left out

seed.description: a number the picks are made from; the same seed and words make the same fixtures

theme.description: what the app is and how it sounds, which the records are written in: `a cozy recipe-sharing community: home cooks posting what they made`

title: What mocks takes (craft-agent/1)
